title: OpenAI据报道3亿美元收购手机摄像头厂商Glass Imaging
content:
According to the Wall Street Journal, OpenAI is acquiring smartphone camera manufacturer Glass Imaging for more than $300 million. Glass Imaging was founded in 2019 and is based in Los Altos, California. It has previously raised about $30 million from investors. OpenAI has not yet responded to this matter.
Glass Imaging was founded by former Apple engineers Ziv Attar and Tom Bishop, who previously led Apple's portrait mode team. The company mainly uses neural networks to learn the imaging characteristics of different camera systems, directly improving image quality when the shutter is pressed, rather than relying on AI post-processing, thus overcoming the imaging limitations caused by the physical size of smartphone cameras.
This acquisition also aligns with OpenAI's ongoing hardware strategy. According to reports, OpenAI is developing hardware products including smartphones, earphones, and AI companion devices. In 2025, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Jony Ive, former Apple design chief, announced a collaboration to develop hardware devices, and later acquired Ive's company for $6.5 billion. The related team formed the hardware startup io.
If the deal is finalized, Glass Imaging's computational photography technology and team experience are expected to further enhance OpenAI's technical capabilities in AI hardware, indicating that OpenAI is expanding from AI software and model capabilities to terminal devices and interaction interfaces.

report.summary: OpenAI被曝3亿美元收购手机影像公司Glass Imaging，加码AI硬件。
report.background: 据《华尔街日报》报道，OpenAI正以逾3亿美元收购手机摄像头技术公司Glass Imaging。该公司2019年成立于加州洛斯阿尔托斯，累计融资仅约3000万美元，创始人为前苹果工程师Ziv Attar和Tom Bishop，二人曾领导苹果人像模式团队。Glass Imaging的核心思路是用神经网络学习不同相机系统的成像特性，在按下快门的瞬间就还原画质，而不是依赖事后AI修图。此举与OpenAI近年的硬件布局一脉相承：2025年Sam Altman与苹果前设计总监Jony Ive宣布合作开发硬件，随后以65亿美元收购其公司io，团队演变为硬件创业公司io。
key_points: Glass Imaging由前苹果人像模式团队负责人创立，主打在拍摄那一刻用神经网络还原画质，而非先拍照再靠AI后期修图。
交易金额超3亿美元，而公司此前累计融资仅约3000万美元，溢价明显，显示OpenAI对影像技术与团队的急切需求。
这是OpenAI硬件路线的最新一步：此前已与Jony Ive合作，并以65亿美元收购其公司io，布局手机、耳机与AI伴侣设备。
手机影像长期受限于传感器物理尺寸，Glass Imaging把神经网络的还原能力下沉到成像管线，用算法抬高小底相机的成像上限。
若交易落地，意味着OpenAI正从模型与软件能力向终端设备与交互界面延伸，硬件或成为其AI能力落地的关键入口。
report.impact: 对AI行业，这意味着大模型竞争正从单纯拼模型转向“模型+硬件”全栈，光学、ISP与端侧推理成为新的收购标的。对开发者，计算摄影、神经渲染与端侧部署的交叉技能会更吃香，相关岗位与工具链需求上升。对普通用户，未来AI硬件可能不再依赖事后修图，抬手一拍就是好照片；但摄像头与AI长期在线的组合也带来隐私与数据合规的新担忧。
report.tools: 想跟进可关注：Halide（可编程图像处理语言）、OpenCV与LibRaw；端侧推理可选ExecuTorch、Core ML、NCNN/MNN；图像复原开源项目如Real-ESRGAN、NAFNet；也可查阅Google HDR+数据集与苹果人像模式相关论文。
